title: Two Lectures on the Phase Diagram of QCD
summary: The phase diagram of QCD at finite temperature and density is discussed. Large numbers of quark colors, $N_{\rm c} >> 1$, is used to explain generic features of the phase diagram. For temperatures below $ T \le 160$~MeV at zero baryon number density, the three dimensional string model is shown to describe the thermodynamics of QCD, and as well, the integrated spectrum of non-Goldstone mesons and glueballs.
